artist.name: Sanjith
artist.bio: Sanjith is a DJ who hosted two boxout.fm shows from 2017: Unequal, with house and techno selections, and Groove Nuggets, with soulful and funky cuts from around the world. He played a deep house, breaks and electro set at the first Boxout Weekender in April 2018.

eras.sound: Deep house, breaks and electro for the dancefloor
